newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street holds higher ground.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street holds higher ground.

text.p: U.S. stocks were strong and steady Friday, continuing to feed off the market's buoyant gains yesterday.

The Dow industrials were up 33 points at 7810, partly supported by lower bond yields. The benchmark 30-year Treasury bond was up 7/32 at a 6.66 percent yield. The Nasdaq composite index rose three points to 1450.
The expiration of index futures and options added some early volatility to the stock market and boosted volume but did not sway share prices, traders said.
